Each night afterward he glanced at it, and the empty horizon felt a little less empty, as though somewhere a stranger kept a vigil that matched his own, patiently, across the water.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一个还没醒来的人。街灯把空荡的马路照得发白，红绿灯徒劳地变换颜色，却没有车停下。便利店的灯还亮着，店员趴在柜台上打盹。远处有一辆洒水车缓缓驶过，水声在寂静里格外清晰。高楼的窗户大多黑着，只有零星几扇透出微光，不知是谁彻夜未眠。风从江边吹来，带着一点凉意和潮气。天边开始泛出淡淡的灰蓝，第一班公交车的灯光，正从街角慢慢靠近。", "w03": "- Imagine standing between two mirrors: you see a smaller copy of yourself inside a smaller copy, over and over.\n- Recursion is when something solves a big problem by doing a tiny bit, then asking a smaller copy of itself to do the rest.\n- It has to stop somewhere, so there's always a simplest case where the copy just answers instead of asking again."}
